Clinic: 4,200 patients, 6 rooms, 12 nurses in 3 shifts. Open 08:00–19:00 weekdays, 09:00–13:00 Saturday. Accreditation runs to April 2027; renewal needs an infection-control audit. Attendance averages 180/day (peak 310, Jan 2025 flu wave); no-shows 9%, down from 14% after reminder texts.

Key incidents: a 2024 vaccine fridge failure (alarm now networked, checked daily, paper log backup); a duplicate record edit overwrote an allergy field (records now lock while open).

Rules: no renewal without a consultation in 12 months; vaccine stock counted twice weekly; temperature excursions above 8°C reported same day.

Pending: ultrasound utilisation study (second machine postponed); nursing coordinator vacant since August 2025, covered by two senior nurses—unsustainable beyond winter.
